question: The ‘Dronacharya Award’ is associated with ________.

options.text: outstanding coaches in sports and games

solution:
The correct answer is __Sports training__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The ‘Dronacharya Award’ is associated with **outstanding coaches in sports and games.**
 
• This award is given to those coaches who have successfully trained sportspersons or teams and enables them to achieve outstanding results in international competitions.
 
• This eminent award was started in the year 1985.
 
• It is given to coaches for their hard work to produce top-level sportspersons.
 
• In this award, the coach is given five lakh rupees cash, the scroll of honour, and a statue of guru Dronacharya.
